name: You can do anything
description:
Indonesia

Kamu bisa melakukan apa saja di sini 😆, jadi tunggu apa lagi? Ayo bergabung sekarang 😆.

Terkadang ada server yang punya aturan ketat, tapi di sini tidak ada aturan yang kaku; yang penting jangan bikin keributan saja, itu saja.

English

You can do anything here 😆, So what are you waiting for? Come join us now 😆.

Sometimes some servers have strict rules, but here there are no strict rules, Just don't make a fuss here, that's all.
